answer: A plume of smoke is easy to fake, but a single violet feather is not: give every agent one unforgeable credential, a quill-signed proof of real work, before it can trade. Sybils can copy identities cheaply, yet each fake must earn its own signed history of completed tasks, and peers only trust agents whose quill signatures chain back to verified deeds. Faking a hundred agents means forging a hundred honest histories, which costs more than the attack gains.
